notes: LTX-2.3 fully distilled FP8, one full-resolution stage, 8 fixed sigmas/CFG1, silent video. Width/height must be multiples of32 and frames8*n+1. Same graph as the real 1190 local 5s test, without dev weights, extra LoRA, upscaler or local prompt LLM. Source: Comfy-Org/workflow_templates video_ltx2_3_i2v.json, adapted; LTX-2 Community License applies to weights.
